description:
Two ways to read better, in one app: speed reading for any book, and learning German by reading real ones.

READ FASTER
• A highlight sweeps through the text at your pace, or words flash one at a time in the center of the screen, so your eyes stop jumping around
• Set your speed anywhere from 40 to 1,500 words per minute
• Natural pauses at commas, sentence ends and paragraphs keep it readable at speed
• See how many minutes are left in the chapter and the book
• Open any EPUB or text file, in any language

LEARN GERMAN BY READING
• Above every German word you do not know yet sits its translation in Portuguese
• Tap the translation once you know a word: it disappears from the whole book, and the page gets cleaner as your vocabulary grows
• German nouns are colored by gender: blue for der, red for die, green for das
• Hold a word you are still learning: it is underlined everywhere and the pace slows for it
• Sentences are read aloud by your device's voice, with the text following along
• Export everything you look up as an Anki deck

BOOKS THAT READ CLEANLY
Page numbers and headers left over from print are removed, sentences broken by a page are joined again, and every book opens at chapter one. A public-domain German storybook is built in so you can start right away.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no tracking, no ads. Everything works without a connection, and your books and progress never leave your device.

The reader is free, open-source software. The dictionary uses Wiktionary data under CC BY-SA 4.0.
promotionalText: Speed read any book, or learn German with a translation above every word you do not know yet.
